segments.name: Maggot Debridement Therapy Product
segments.description: Sells medical grade sterile blowfly larvae bio-dressing products for chronic wound debridement to hospitals and clinics.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we manufactured and distributed a line of medical grade sterile blowfly larvae bio-dressing products marketed under the MEDIFLY brand name, or the MEDIFLY products.

segments.name: Cosmeceutical Product
segments.description: Sells cosmeceutical skincare products directly to individual customers through retailers, gyms and online platforms.
segments.evidence: For our cosmeceuticals business, we introduced three products in 2023, including a hydrating balm product, a muscle energy cream and a pain relief muscle patch.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals and clinics buy wound care maggot products, and individual customers buy cosmeceutical products through retailers and online platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers primarily include major public and private hospitals and clinics in Singapore.
